name: appconfigdata
description: AppConfig Data provides the data plane APIs your application uses to retrieve configuration data.

subcommands.name: get-latest-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the latest deployed configuration. This API may return empty configuration data if the client already has the latest version.

options.name: --configuration-token
options.description: Token describing the current state of the configuration session. To obtain a token, first call the StartConfigurationSession API.

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: start-configuration-session
subcommands.description: Starts a configuration session used to retrieve a deployed configuration.

options.name: --application-identifier
options.description: The application ID or the application name

options.name: --environment-identifier
options.description: The environment ID or the environment name

options.name: --configuration-profile-identifier
options.description: The configuration profile ID or the configuration profile name

options.name: --required-minimum-poll-interval-in-seconds

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
